title: Count Palindrome Partitions
statement:
Given a string S, count the number of ways to partition it into substrings where every substring is a palindrome.

For example, "aab" can be partitioned as ["a","a","b"] or ["aa","b"] — both are palindrome partitions, so the answer is 2.
inputFormat: A single line containing the string S.
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of palindrome partitions.
constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 15
S contains only lowercase English letters.

starterCode.python:
s = input().strip()
# Write your solution here
# Hint: backtrack from each index, try all palindromic prefixes
